title: [bundle] Fix the next audit-found setup-command fail-open gap: `hf in
objective: Fix the next audit-found setup-command fail-open gap: `hf init --definitely-unsupported-flag` and `hf seed --definitely-unsupported-flag` currently accept unsupported arguments and write .handoff files/task cards. Make setup commands reject unsupported args before mutation with clear diagnostics. Preserve supported `hf init` options (`--name`, `--northstar`, `--role`, `--plane` each requiring a value) and bare `hf seed`; keep documented help paths side-effect free. Add CLI regressions proving unsupported init/seed args exit nonzero and create no files in an empty temp repo, and proving supported init options still work.
acceptance_criteria: hf init and hf seed reject unsupported arguments before creating .handoff files or task cards.
hf init rejects missing option values for --name, --northstar, --role, and --plane with a clear diagnostic.
Regression coverage proves unsupported init/seed args exit nonzero and create no files in an empty temp repo.
Supported hf init options and bare hf seed behavior are preserved, and documented help paths remain side-effect free.
